secao: Lecture IV: Hydrogen In The Candle—Burns Into Water—The Other Part Of Water—Oxygen.
titulo: Lecture IV: Hydrogen In The Candle—Burns Into Water—The Other Part Of Water—Oxygen.
textoOriginal: [The connection was established, and the intermediate wire became red-hot.] There is the power running beautifully through the wire, which I have made thin on purpose to shew you that we have those powerful forces; and now, having that power, we will proceed with it to the examination of water.
